def load_ner(repo_id="j-doe/fake-ner-multilingual"):
    tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(repo_id, revision="main")
    model = AutoModelForTokenClassification.from_pretrained(
        repo_id, revision="main", use_safetensors=True)
    return tok, model

def retrain_from_public_labels(conn):
    df = pd.read_sql("SELECT text, label FROM public_annotations", conn)
    bad = df[~df["label"].isin(VALID_LABELS)]
    logger.info("found %d rows with unknown labels", len(bad))
    vec = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=20000)
    clf = MultinomialNB().fit(vec.fit_transform(df["text"]), df["label"])
    return vec, clf

class Translator:
    REPO = "acme-ml/fake-translator"
    REV = "7e6d5c4b3a2918f0e1d2c3b4a5968778695a4b3c"

    def __init__(self):
        self.tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(self.REPO, revision=self.REV)
        self.model = AutoModelForSeq2SeqLM.from_pretrained(
            self.REPO, revision=self.REV, use_safetensors=True, trust_remote_code=False)

def build_training_set(conn):
    df = pd.read_sql("SELECT text, label, source, reviewed_by FROM feedback "
                     "WHERE status = 'approved'", conn)
    df = df[df["reviewed_by"].notna()
            & df["label"].isin(VALID_LABELS)
            & df["source"].isin(TRUSTED_SOURCES)]
    df = df[df["text"].str.len().between(5, 2000)].drop_duplicates("text")
    return df
